content: this legal text summarizes a civil case in the klaipeda district court the case involves a matrimonial property dispute between two parties referred to as the applicant and the defendant the court has ordered the defendant to pay various costs including stamp duty and professional fees the applicant is responsible for their own professional fees the court has resolved the case by awarding the applicant compensation for half of an apartment and ordering the defendant to pay a specific amount to the applicant the applicant has requested the court to order the defendant to pay for costs incurred by the deceased care credit and a debt for maintenance of the common property the applicant also wants the property to be divided and for the defendant to pay compensation for the difference in value the defendant disputes the valuation of the property and proposes an alternative division the court has upheld the applicants application and ordered the defendant to pay half of the costs incurred the court has also discussed the division of property in a community property case awarding specific properties to each party and ordering the payment of various costs and expenses

civil_codes_used: Art. 5.52 Liability for the debts of the deceased of an heir who has taken possession of the estate after taking possession of the property or after filing a declaration with the notary
metadata.cost: - € 518,00 (stamp duty) + € 200,00 (professional fees) to be borne by the defendant; € 1 080,00 (professional fees) to be borne by the plaintiff.
metadata.subject_of_succession: Immovable property: the apartment, a plot of land, a dwelling house, an outbuilding, a shed, a garage, an outbuilding 1, an outbuilding 2
